item.title: ACP Success Stories
item.description:
• Toulbar2 a CP solver helped in designing a stable and self-assembling protein by organizing thousands of atoms in a favorable configuration in space. Toulbar2 is available on Github.

    Read more…

  • You need to buy a new car and want to try out configurations to know what can be done or is affordable? It is now possible if your car dealer uses the SAP S/4HANA tool. It uses the constraint solver Gecode to ensure that configurations are valid and that no restrictions are violated.

item.title: Publication Venues
item.description:
Primary conferences

  • The International Conference on Principles and Practice of Constraint Programming (CP) is a central publishing and meeting place for CP research CP Conference series page
  • Another venue that has CP at its core is the International Conference on the Integration of Constraint Programming, Artificial Intelligence, and Operations Research CPAIOR Conference series page

Primary journal

  • The Constraints journal provides a common forum for the many disciplines interested in constraint programming and constraint satisfaction and optimization, and the many application domains in which constraint technology is employed.
